units.time: REAL seconds (game minutes only in a trip's dep/arr)

walk.note: hightop perk ×1.5 (the sim applies it: travel.mjs opt.walkMul)

subway.note: a line with its own clock (transit.lines[].speed, dwellS, fare) runs at that and costs that; a ride costs the highest fare of the lines it uses

taxi.note: ride s = the city's car alone on the ride's road path from its departure second (travel.mjs carDrive: drive.car's IDM at each lane's graph.road.v0 and each connector's graph.road.cv, the fixed-time lights graph.road.sigc on the signal clock = game minute × 2.5, the zebras graph.road.bands) + drive.out s to get out (+ drive.pull s out of a stand's kerb slot); with no departure second the mean over drive.phases departures; speed only picks the kerbs; fare = (base + per100 × ride metres / 100) × night; the Director's rush multiplier is the sim's
